# Elgato Key Light

Control Elgato Key Light power, brightness, white temperature and requested identification through Muse Home Link, using the local HTTP light API on the documented device only: board type 53 (Air, Mini and Light Strip are distinct variants outside this skill). The local HTTP API is unauthenticated, which the skill discloses plainly; that does not waive host/action authorization, and the API must never be exposed outside the trusted network. Serial, MAC and network metadata are kept private.
